run_advpromptset_generation: run main.py with a data directory argument to generate the AdvPromptSet dataset from Jigsaw data
run_process_jigsaw_1: run process_jigsaw_1 to preprocess the Jigsaw Toxic Comment Classification Challenge dataset
run_process_jigsaw_2: run process_jigsaw_2 to preprocess the Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification dataset
run_process_jigsaw_all: run process_jigsaw_all to merge and preprocess both Jigsaw datasets into a unified dataframe
run_augment_row: run augment_row to split comments into sentences and filter by length and content
